decide.ts: tt.decide("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today").then((call) => call.results[0].value)

choose.ts: tt.choose({choose: "Which team owns this?", options: ["billing", "shipping"]}, "please route this ticket").then(call => call.results[0].value)

tag.ts: tt.tag({tag: "Which topics apply?", labels: ["refund", "shipping"]}, "the refund and the shipping").then(call => call.results[0].value)

score.ts: tt.score({score: "How urgent is this?", levels: ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."]}, "maybe later").then(call => call.results[0].value)

filter.ts: tt.filter("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"]).then((call) => call.results.map(row => row.input))

rank.ts: tt.rank("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"], { top: 1 }).then((call) => call.results.map(row => row.index))

find.ts: tt.find("Which line asks for money back?", ["I want a refund", "good morning"]).then((call) => call.results[0].value)

annotate.ts: tt.annotate({ version: 1, questions: { wants_refund: { decide: "Does the customer ask for a refund?" }, urgency: { score: "How urgent is this?", levels: ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."] } } }, ["maybe later"]).then((call) => call.results.map(row => row.value))

recognize.ts: tt.recognize({version:1,recognize:{kinds:{person:"A person's name."}}}, "Le café 😀 Maria Chen arrived.").then(call => call.results[0].value.entities.map(entity => entity.text))
